pull.title: MINOR: Replace try/fail/catch with assertThrows in remaining Streams tests
pull.body:
Replace the remaining straightforward try/fail/catch exception
assertions in the Streams tests with `assertThrows`, following #23277
and #23389.

In #23389, streams.internals, streams.state.internals,
streams.processor.internals, and streams.integration were left unchanged
because they overlapped with in-flight Hamcrest removal work.
The referenced PRs (#23307, #23386, and #23387) have since been merged,
and KAFKA-21028 has been resolved. This PR covers the remaining
straightforward assertions in streams.state.internals,
streams.processor.internals, and streams.integration, along with those
in streams.kstream.internals, streams.processor, and streams/test-utils.

Where the catch block checked the exception message, the `assertThrows`
return value is used to keep that check. Descriptive `fail()` messages
are kept, and generic ones are replaced with messages that name the
rejected operation. Unused `fail` imports are removed.

In `FineGrainedAutoResetIntegrationTest`, only `builder.build()` is
wrapped, because the overlapping source is rejected when the topology
is built, not when `stream()` is called. In
`TimeOrderedKeyValueBufferTest#shouldNotRestoreUnrecognizedVersionRecord`,
the `finally` block that cleans up the buffer is kept.

Left unchanged:
- `GlobalStateTaskTest`: `fail()` is conditional on a test parameter,
  so it is not a direct try/fail/catch.
- `KafkaStreamsTest#shouldThrowTopologyExceptionOnEmptyTopology`: same
  reason as in #23389 (the `fail()` sits inside try-with-resources).
- `TimeOrderedKeyValueBufferTest` still imports `fail` for the
  `default` branch of a switch in a callback.

Testing:

```sh
./gradlew :streams:checkstyleTest :streams:spotlessCheck \
    :streams:test-utils:checkstyleTest :streams:integration-tests:checkstyleTest
./gradlew :streams:test \
    --tests org.apache.kafka.streams.state.internals.CompositeReadOnlyWindowStoreTest \
    --tests org.apache.kafka.streams.state.internals.CompositeReadOnlySessionStoreTest \
    --tests org.apache.kafka.streams.state.internals.MaybeTest \
    --tests org.apache.kafka.streams.state.internals.TimeOrderedKeyValueBufferTest \
    --tests org.apache.kafka.streams.processor.internals.ProcessorContextImplTest \
    --tests org.apache.kafka.streams.processor.UsePartitionTimeOnInvalidTimestampTest \
    --tests org.apache.kafka.streams.kstream.internals.KStreamPeekTest \
    --tests org.apache.kafka.streams.kstream.internals.KTableTransformValuesTest
./gradlew :streams:test-utils:test --tests org.apache.kafka.streams.MockProcessorContextTest
./gradlew :streams:integration-tests:test \
    --tests org.apache.kafka.streams.integration.FineGrainedAutoResetIntegrationTest
```

Reviewers: Ken Huang <s7133700@gmail.com>
